summary_zh: 前文是英国 Amazon/Prime 用户抱怨笔记本页面宣称当日达、结账却不兑现，指服务变差和虚假广告。随后他人以自身延迟配送经历引出 主品牌，并补充 JoyExpress 覆盖城市与时效。收录帖仅表示首次听说并感谢，未继续评价，说明话题由亚马逊负面体验转向竞品配送信息，情绪较理性，传播价值在替代平台被自然推荐。

posts.text: I am tired of being an @amazon uk based customer @AmazonUK  Prime member paying a fee and in the past got a good service, only now to be taken for a "Mug" and suffer your false advertising, I choose a laptop for my wife today, and it clearly stated delivery today if I ordered now (within 1hr 22min, and only to find again at checkout this is blatantly untrue
posts.original_text: I am tired of being an @amazon uk based customer @AmazonUK  Prime member paying a fee and in the past got a good service, only now to be taken for a "Mug" and suffer your false advertising, I choose a laptop for my wife today, and it clearly stated delivery today if I ordered now (within 1hr 22min, and only to find again at checkout this is blatantly untrue
posts.translation_zh: 我已经受够了作为一名英国的 @amazon 客户、@AmazonUK Prime 会员，付着会员费，过去还能得到不错的服务，可现在却被当成“冤大头”，还要承受你们的虚假广告。今天我给我妻子选了一台笔记本电脑，页面清楚写着如果我现在下单就能今天送达（在 1 小时 22 分钟内下单），结果到了结账时又发现这明目张胆地不是真的
